text: Some senior U.S. officials have said they will probe Chinese AI firms for allegedly "distilling" U.S. frontier models and could sanction them for "stealing U.S. intellectual property." MOFCOM spokesperson said Beijing opposes politicizing and instrumentalizing tech and trade issu
text_zh: 部分美国高级官员称，将调查中国AI企业涉嫌“蒸馏”美国前沿模型，并可能因“窃取美国知识产权”实施制裁。中国商务部发言人表示，北京反对将科技和贸易问题政治化、工具化。
